svg.title: Lothlórien
svg.desc: The Golden Wood stands west of Anduin and north of Celebrant. Nimrodel joins Celebrant; Cerin Amroth is north of Caras Galadhon. Original regional interpretation; north up; no numerical scale.

g.text: The Golden Wood between Celebrant and Anduin
NORTH UP · REGIONAL SCALE · THIRD AGE
